claim: Owner/manager-only content no longer reaches a staff socket (fix/websocket-role-gate, found by the ADR 0090 security review of PR #493). PromotionExtractorService's promotion toast and its daily digest go through WebsocketGateway.emitRoleNotification(rid, OWNER_AND_MANAGER), which reads roles at send time (houseMembersInRoles in common/tenant/live-membership.ts: user_restaurant_access only, isLiveMembership, no users.restaurant_id fallback, throws on a failed read) and emits to member:<rid>:<uid> rooms, outside the restaurant: prefix that subscribe:restaurant builds; a failed read emits nothing. The digest's inbox rows go through persistManagerNotification's roles option. The bridge passes msg.fields.routingKey to its handlers, and notification.promo_alert (the orchestrator's provider_promotions alerts) is owner_manager in NOTIFICATION_AUDIENCE_BY_KEY, which classifies every notification.* routing-key literal under services/ (a new publisher fails this row until classified). The market-price producer narrows its audience to owner/manager (the /vendor-intel gate) and writes at priority low, so no push carries a vendor and amounts to a locked screen (ADR 0175 D3). POST /notifications no longer fans a member's row to restaurant:<id>, has a DTO, and refuses an actionUrl that safeActionPath does not reduce to an in-app path. endStaleSessions reads the Namespace's socket map, so a password change closes the sockets (ADR 0225). The prospect notice links to /communications (ADR 0160 Open item 3). The role-reader count on user_restaurant_access is pinned at 7. Behaviour: websocket/websocket-audiences.spec.ts (21 cases, 20 red on 46c3fdb5d), market-price.producer.spec.ts (2 new, red on 46c3fdb5d), password-change-ends-sessions.spec.ts (Namespace-shaped mock, 2 red on 46c3fdb5d); 17 of 17 source mutations killed by those specs and 8 of 8 by this verify, 2026-09-28. This verify fails on 46c3fdb5d with 20 reasons.
